kernel: ThunderKittens tcgen05 + TMA GEMM, adapted from educational_b200/level_06 (naive tcgen05, no warp-specialized pipelining / 2-CTA cluster). BF16 in, FP32 TMEM accum, BF16 out.
build: load_inline on nvidia/cuda:13.0.0-devel + torch 2.13.0+cu130, TK cloned to /opt/tk, -gencode arch=compute_100a,code=sm_100a -std=c++20 --use_fast_math -DKITTENS_SM100, extra_ldflags -lcuda -lcudadevrt
verdict: REJECTED. The tcgen05 TK kernel (level_06 class, 293 TFLOPs at 4096^3 - matches TK's published number) is 0.19-0.56x cuBLAS on every shape. TK's published production ceiling (1540 TFLOPs) only ties the measured cuBLAS BF16 (1546-1588) and is itself available via torch.matmul(bf16). Neither beats the shipped TF32 (won on accuracy at 16384) or MXFP8 (3466 TFLOP/s at 32768) trailing. The GEMM primitive is not the bottleneck (the serial diagonal factorization is), so a faster GEMM cannot move the geomean. Closes levers.md lever #3.
